def create_or_confirm_host_recipe(
    parent: Optional[QWidget],
    db_path: str,
    *,
    reason: str,
    created_by: str,
    confirm_title: str = "Create host recipe",
    confirm_body: str = "",
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Probe → primary GPU prompt (multi-GPU) → Yes/No → create or update.

    Used by Bringup, Maintenance reset rebuild, and Navigation Station so the
    same question cannot be skipped by a silent ``ensure_recipe``.
    """
    import json

    from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QMessageBox

    from WarpCore import host_recipe as hr

    live = hr.probe_hardware()
    current = hr.get_current_recipe(db_path)
    need_create = current is None
    need_confirm = hr.needs_primary_ai_gpu_prompt(
        live, (current or {}).get("recipe") if current else None
    )
    if not need_create and not need_confirm:
        return current

    built = propose_recipe_with_primary_prompt(
        parent, hardware=live, force_primary_prompt=need_confirm
    )
    if built is None:
        return None
    live, proposed = built
    preview = json.dumps(
        {
            "gpu_policy": proposed.get("gpu_policy"),
            "embed_gpu_index": proposed.get("embed_gpu_index"),
            "chat_gpu_index": proposed.get("chat_gpu_index"),
            "tensor_split": proposed.get("tensor_split"),
            "embed_n_ctx": proposed.get("embed_n_ctx"),
            "chat_n_ctx": proposed.get("chat_n_ctx"),
            "gpu_summary": proposed.get("gpu_summary"),
            "host_ram_gb": proposed.get("host_ram_gb"),
        },
        indent=2,
    )
    body = confirm_body.strip() or (
        "No host recipe yet. Create Launch defaults from this machine?"
        if need_create
        else "Confirm the primary AI GPU and save an updated host recipe?"
    )
    reply = QMessageBox.question(
        parent,
        confirm_title,
        f"{body}\n\n{preview}\n\n"
        "(You can Update later in Engineering Maintenance → Recipe.)",
        QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes,
    )
    if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
        return None
    if need_create:
        return hr.create_recipe(
            db_path,
            hardware=live,
            recipe=proposed,
            reason=reason,
            created_by=created_by,
        )
    return hr.update_recipe(
        db_path,
        reason=reason,
        hardware=live,
        recipe=proposed,
        created_by=created_by,
    )

def prompt_primary_ai_gpu(
    parent: Optional[QWidget],
    hardware: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Optional[int]:
    """Ask which GPU runs embed + chat when the host has more than one.

    Returns the chosen nvidia-smi index, the sole GPU index when there is only
    one card, or ``None`` if the user cancels the multi-GPU dialog.
    """
    from WarpCore import host_recipe as hr

    rows = hr.gpu_choice_rows(hardware)
    if not rows:
        return 0
    if len(rows) == 1:
        return int(rows[0]["index"]) if rows[0].get("index") is not None else 0

    default = hr.default_primary_ai_gpu_index(hardware)
    # parent=None + ApplicationModal: avoids dialogs stuck behind SuiteShell.
    dlg = QDialog(None)
    dlg.setWindowTitle("Primary AI GPU")
    dlg.setWindowModality(Qt.WindowModality.ApplicationModal)
    dlg.setMinimumWidth(560)
    layout = QVBoxLayout(dlg)
    layout.addWidget(
        QLabel(
            "This machine has multiple GPUs.\n"
            "Which GPU should run embedding and chat LLM servers?\n\n"
            "Pick the compute card if another GPU is used for video/display\n"
            "(for example Quadro P2200 for monitors, RTX 6000 for AI)."
        )
    )
    group = QButtonGroup(dlg)
    radios: list = []
    for r in rows:
        # GPU 0 is valid — never use ``index or 0``.
        idx = int(r["index"]) if r.get("index") is not None else 0
        btn = QRadioButton(str(r.get("label") or f"GPU {idx}"))
        if idx == default:
            btn.setChecked(True)
        group.addButton(btn)
        layout.addWidget(btn)
        radios.append((btn, idx))
    if not any(b.isChecked() for b, _ in radios) and radios:
        radios[0][0].setChecked(True)

    buttons = QDialogButtonBox(
        QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok | QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel
    )
    buttons.accepted.connect(dlg.accept)
    buttons.rejected.connect(dlg.reject)
    layout.addWidget(buttons)
    dlg.show()
    dlg.raise_()
    dlg.activateWindow()
    if dlg.exec() != QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
        return None
    for btn, idx in radios:
        if btn.isChecked():
            return idx
    return default

def find_port_listener(port: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """The process listening on ``port``, if one can be seen.

    A llama-server whose command line names the port counts even when the
    socket table is hidden. Any other listener is returned as foreign so the
    Launch button will not kill it.
    """
    try:
        import psutil
    except ImportError:
        return None
    port_i = int(port)
    llama_pid: Optional[int] = None
    try:
        processes = list(psutil.process_iter(["pid", "name", "cmdline"]))
    except Exception:
        processes = []
    for proc in processes:
        info = proc.info if hasattr(proc, "info") else {}
        name = str(info.get("name") or "")
        if "llama-server" not in name.lower():
            continue
        cmd = list(info.get("cmdline") or [])
        if _cmdline_port(cmd, port_i):
            try:
                llama_pid = int(info.get("pid") or proc.pid)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                continue
            break
    listen_pid: Optional[int] = None
    listen_name = ""
    try:
        connections = psutil.net_connections(kind="inet")
    except Exception:
        connections = []
    for conn in connections:
        status = str(getattr(conn, "status", "") or "")
        if status != getattr(psutil, "CONN_LISTEN", "LISTEN") and status != "LISTEN":
            continue
        laddr = getattr(conn, "laddr", None)
        if laddr is None or int(getattr(laddr, "port", -1) or -1) != port_i:
            continue
        pid = getattr(conn, "pid", None)
        name = ""
        if pid:
            try:
                name = str(psutil.Process(int(pid)).name() or "")
            except Exception:
                name = ""
        listen_pid = int(pid) if pid else None
        listen_name = name
        if "llama-server" in name.lower():
            return {
                "pid": listen_pid,
                "name": name or "llama-server",
                "is_llama_server": True,
            }
        return {
            "pid": listen_pid,
            "name": name,
            "is_llama_server": False,
        }
    if llama_pid is not None:
        return {"pid": llama_pid, "name": "llama-server", "is_llama_server": True}
    return None

def flag_value(argv: List[str], names: tuple) -> str:
    """Value of the first matching flag. ``--flag=value`` and ``--flag value``."""
    wanted = {name.lower() for name in names}
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        token = argv[i]
        low = token.lower()
        for name in wanted:
            if low == name:
                if i + 1 < len(argv):
                    return argv[i + 1]
                return ""
            prefix = name + "="
            if low.startswith(prefix):
                return token.split("=", 1)[1]
        i += 1
    return ""

Stop llama-server on this port and start the same command again.

A NaN embedding poisons that GPU process. Later requests stay null until the process is replaced. A server on any other port is left running.

Source code in spock_shell\llama_gui_command.py 
def restart_llama_server(port: int, wait_s: float = 60.0) -> str:
    """Stop llama-server on this port and start the same command again.

    A NaN embedding poisons that GPU process. Later requests stay null until
    the process is replaced. A server on any other port is left running.
    """
    import subprocess
    import time
    import urllib.request

    listener = find_port_listener(port)
    if not listener or not listener.get("is_llama_server") or not listener.get("pid"):
        return f"Could not restart: port {int(port)} has no llama-server."
    pid = int(listener["pid"])
    try:
        import psutil

        proc = psutil.Process(pid)
        argv = [str(part) for part in (proc.cmdline() or [])]
        try:
            env = proc.environ()
        except Exception:
            env = os.environ.copy()
        try:
            cwd = proc.cwd()
        except Exception:
            cwd = None
    except Exception as exc:
        return f"Could not restart llama-server on port {int(port)}: {exc}"
    if not argv:
        return f"Could not restart: llama-server on port {int(port)} has no command line."
    _terminate_pid_tree(pid)
    log_dir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "logs")
    os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    log_path = os.path.join(log_dir, f"llama-server-port{int(port)}-{stamp}.log")
    flags = 0
    if os.name == "nt":
        flags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0) | getattr(
            subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP", 0
        )
    try:
        with open(log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as log_fp:
            subprocess.Popen(
                argv,
                cwd=cwd or None,
                env=env,
                stdout=log_fp,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                creationflags=flags,
            )
    except Exception as exc:
        return f"Could not restart llama-server on port {int(port)}: {exc}"
    health = f"http://127.0.0.1:{int(port)}/health"
    deadline = time.time() + float(wait_s)
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(health, timeout=2) as resp:
                if resp.status == 200:
                    return (
                        f"Restarted llama-server on port {int(port)} "
                        f"after a null embedding. Log: {log_path}"
                    )
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(0.5)
    return (
        f"Could not restart: llama-server on port {int(port)} did not become healthy. "
        f"Log: {log_path}"
    )

Source code in spock_shell\llama_gui_command.py 
def split_llama_gui_command(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Split a View Command line the way Llama GUI quoteArg would rejoin it."""
    tokens: List[str] = []
    buf: List[str] = []
    in_quote = False
    i = 0
    source = text or ""
    while i < len(source):
        ch = source[i]
        if in_quote:
            if ch == "\\" and i + 1 < len(source) and source[i + 1] == '"':
                buf.append('"')
                i += 2
                continue
            if ch == '"':
                in_quote = False
                i += 1
                continue
            buf.append(ch)
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch == '"':
            in_quote = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            if buf:
                tokens.append("".join(buf))
                buf = []
            i += 1
            continue
        buf.append(ch)
        i += 1
    if in_quote:
        raise ValueError("The Llama GUI command has an unclosed quote.")
    if buf:
        tokens.append("".join(buf))
    return tokens

def best_fit_ids(
    *,
    role: str = "chat",
    limit: int = 6,
    timeout_s: float = 30.0,
) -> List[str]:
    """Top model names / GGUF repos from the dashboard, else empty (caller falls back)."""
    overrides = {"limit": max(1, int(limit))}
    try:
        from llmfit_session_criteria import filters_as_query

        filters = filters_as_query(role=role, overrides=overrides)
    except Exception:
        filters = dict(overrides)
    payload = query_models(role=role, filters=filters, timeout_s=timeout_s)
    if not payload:
        return []
    models = payload.get("models")
    if not isinstance(models, list):
        return []
    out: List[str] = []
    seen = set()
    for row in models:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        candidates: List[str] = []
        name = str(row.get("name") or "").strip()
        if name:
            candidates.append(name)
        for src in row.get("gguf_sources") or []:
            if isinstance(src, dict):
                repo = str(src.get("repo") or "").strip()
                if repo:
                    candidates.append(repo)
        for cand in candidates:
            key = cand.lower()
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            out.append(cand)
            break
        if len(out) >= max(1, int(limit)):
            break
    return out

def dashboard_available(*, timeout_s: float = 1.5) -> bool:
    """True when ``GET /health`` succeeds on the dashboard base URL."""
    try:

        import urllib.request

        req = urllib.request.Request(
            dashboard_base() + "/health",

            if resp.status != 200:

        data = json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
        return isinstance(data, dict) and str(data.get("status") or "").lower() == "ok"
    except Exception:
        return False

def dashboard_rows_as_hub(
    *,
    role: str = "chat",
    limit: int = 6,
    timeout_s: float = 30.0,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Map dashboard model rows into Hub-ish dicts for ``top_role_fits``."""
    overrides = {"limit": max(1, int(limit))}
    try:
        from llmfit_session_criteria import filters_as_query

        filters = filters_as_query(role=role, overrides=overrides)
    except Exception:
        filters = dict(overrides)
    payload = query_models(role=role, filters=filters, timeout_s=timeout_s)
    if not payload:
        return []
    kind = "embedding" if role in ("embed", "embedding") else "chat"
    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in payload.get("models") or []:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        mid = ""
        for src in row.get("gguf_sources") or []:
            if isinstance(src, dict) and src.get("repo"):
                mid = str(src["repo"]).strip()
                break
        if not mid:
            mid = str(row.get("name") or "").strip()
        if not mid:
            continue
        try:
            size_b = float(row.get("params_b") or 0.0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            size_b = 0.0
        hub = {
            "id": mid,
            "size_b": size_b,
            "kind": kind,
            "native_ctx": int(row.get("context_length") or row.get("usable_context") or 8192),
            "fit_level": row.get("fit_level") or row.get("fit_label"),
            "estimated_tps": row.get("estimated_tps"),
            "score": int(round(float(row.get("score") or 0.0))),
            "source": "llmfit-dashboard",
            "llmfit_best_quant": row.get("best_quant"),
        }
        rows.append(hub)
    return rows

def enrich_hub_row_with_fit(

    *,

) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Attach estimated_tps / fit_level / llmfit_run_mode when a match exists."""

    hit = lookup_fit_estimate(mid, index=index)

    if hit.get("estimated_tps") is not None:

    if hit.get("run_mode"):
        out["llmfit_run_mode"] = hit["run_mode"]
    if hit.get("best_quant"):
        out.setdefault("llmfit_best_quant", hit["best_quant"])
    return out

def hardware_fingerprint(system_payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> str:
    """Stable key for caching fit estimates against this machine."""
    payload = system_payload if system_payload is not None else system_info_cached()
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return "unknown"
    sysinfo = payload.get("system") if isinstance(payload.get("system"), dict) else payload
    if not isinstance(sysinfo, dict):
        return "unknown"
    gpu = str(sysinfo.get("gpu_name") or "")
    try:
        vram = float(sysinfo.get("gpu_vram_gb") or 0.0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        vram = 0.0
    try:
        ram = float(sysinfo.get("total_ram_gb") or 0.0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        ram = 0.0
    backend = str(sysinfo.get("backend") or "")
    return f"{backend}|{gpu}|{vram:.1f}|{ram:.0f}"

def lookup_fit_estimate(
    model_id: str,
    *,
    index: Optional[Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Match an HF / catalog id to a cached llmfit fit row."""
    key = _normalize_model_key(model_id)
    if not key:
        return None
    idx = index if index is not None else fit_estimate_index()
    if key in idx:
        return idx[key]
    # Substring / containment fallback for publisher-prefixed ids
    best: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    best_len = 0
    for k, entry in idx.items():
        if len(k) < 6:
            continue
        if k in key or key in k:
            if len(k) > best_len:
                best = entry
                best_len = len(k)
    return best

def model_hint_from_path(model_path: str) -> str:
    """Best-effort selector string for ``llmfit plan`` from a GGUF path."""
    stem = Path(model_path).stem
    # Strip common quant suffixes so llmfit can fuzzy-match the catalog name.
    stem = re.sub(
        r"[.\-_](Q\d+_K(_[MSXL])?|Q\d+_0|IQ\d+_XXS|f16|fp16|bf16)$",
        "",
        stem,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    return stem.replace("_", "-")

def query_models(
    *,
    role: str = "chat",
    filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    timeout_s: float = 30.0,
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """``GET /api/v1/models`` with session criteria (or explicit ``filters``).

    Returns the JSON envelope, or ``None`` when the dashboard is offline /
    returns non-JSON. Never raises for connectivity failures.
    """
    try:
        import urllib.error
        import urllib.parse
        import urllib.request

        from llmfit_session_criteria import filters_as_query

        params = filters if isinstance(filters, dict) else filters_as_query(role=role)
        query = urllib.parse.urlencode(
            {k: v for k, v in params.items() if v is not None and v != ""},
            doseq=True,
        )
        url = dashboard_base() + "/api/v1/models"
        if query:
            url = url + "?" + query
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url, headers={"Accept": "application/json"}, method="GET"
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout_s) as resp:
            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        data = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else None
    except Exception:
        return None

def resolve_ngl(
    model_path: str,
    *,
    n_ctx: int = 8192,
    quant: Optional[str] = None,
    current_ngl: str = "-1",
    use_llmfit: bool = True,
) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    """Resolve launch ``-ngl``.

    When ``current_ngl`` is not the sentinel ``-1`` / ``auto``, it wins.
    Otherwise consult llmfit plan for the GGUF stem.
    """
    cur = (current_ngl or "-1").strip()
    if cur.lower() == "auto":
        cur = "-1"
    if cur != "-1":
        return cur, "explicit -ngl"

    if not use_llmfit or not available():
        return "-1", "llmfit unavailable"

    hint = model_hint_from_path(model_path)
    raw = _cached_plan(hint, int(n_ctx), quant or "")
    plan_data = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
    return suggest_ngl_from_payloads(plan_data=plan_data)

docs.text:
Derive a llama-server -ngl value from llmfit JSON.

Returns (ngl, reason). Falls back to -1 (full offload) when the payloads do not justify a safer partial/CPU setting.

Source code in spock_shell\llmfit_bridge.py 
def suggest_ngl_from_payloads(
    *,
    plan_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    model_row: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    """Derive a llama-server ``-ngl`` value from llmfit JSON.

    Returns ``(ngl, reason)``. Falls back to ``-1`` (full offload) when the
    payloads do not justify a safer partial/CPU setting.
    """
    if model_row:
        from_verify = parse_ngl_from_verify_command(str(model_row.get("verify_command") or ""))
        run_mode = str(model_row.get("run_mode") or model_row.get("run_mode_label") or "").lower()
        avail = model_row.get("memory_available_gb")
        req = model_row.get("memory_required_gb")
        fit_level = str(model_row.get("fit_level") or model_row.get("fit_label") or "").lower()

        if "cpu" in run_mode and "gpu" not in run_mode and "offload" not in run_mode:
            return "0", "llmfit run_mode=CPU"

        try:
            avail_f = float(avail) if avail is not None else None
            req_f = float(req) if req is not None else None
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            avail_f = req_f = None

        if avail_f is not None and req_f is not None and req_f > 0 and avail_f < req_f * 0.92:
            # Oversubscribed: map free fraction onto 1..99 layers (llmfit verify uses 99).
            frac = max(0.05, min(0.95, (avail_f / req_f) * 0.85))
            ngl = str(max(1, min(99, int(round(99 * frac)))))
            return ngl, f"llmfit VRAM tight ({avail_f:.1f}/{req_f:.1f} GiB) → partial -ngl {ngl}"

        if from_verify and fit_level in ("perfect", "good", ""):
            return from_verify, f"llmfit verify_command -ngl {from_verify}"

        if fit_level in ("perfect", "good") or "gpu" in run_mode:
            return "-1", f"llmfit fit_level={fit_level or 'gpu'}"

    if plan_data:
        current = plan_data.get("current") if isinstance(plan_data.get("current"), dict) else {}
        run_mode = str(current.get("run_mode") or "").lower()
        fit_level = str(current.get("fit_level") or "").lower()
        if run_mode in ("cpu", "cpu_only") or fit_level == "impossible":
            return "0", f"llmfit plan run_mode={run_mode or fit_level}"
        if "offload" in run_mode:
            return "24", "llmfit plan suggests CPU+GPU offload (conservative -ngl 24)"
        if fit_level in ("perfect", "good") or run_mode in ("gpu",):
            return "-1", f"llmfit plan fit_level={fit_level or run_mode}"

    return "-1", "llmfit default full offload"

def system_info_cached(*, refresh: bool = False) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Session-cached ``llmfit --json system``.

    The raw call is a subprocess with a 45 s timeout, and it sits behind every
    Hub query through ``hardware_fingerprint``. Hardware does not change
    mid-session, so probe once and hand back a copy.

    if refresh:

    raw = _system_info_json()
    if not raw:
        return None

Source code in spock_shell\llmfit_bridge.py 
def system_to_gpu_list(system_payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Convert ``llmfit --json system`` into scanner-style GPU dicts."""
    if not isinstance(system_payload, dict):
        return []
    sysinfo = system_payload.get("system") if isinstance(system_payload.get("system"), dict) else system_payload
    if not isinstance(sysinfo, dict):
        return []
    out: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    gpus = sysinfo.get("gpus")
    if isinstance(gpus, list) and gpus:
        for g in gpus:
            if not isinstance(g, dict):
                continue
            name = str(g.get("name") or "").strip()
            if not name:
                continue
            # Skip useless display-only iGPUs when llmfit marks tiny/null VRAM
            # and a discrete GPU is also present (filter later if needed).
            try:
                vram_gb = float(g.get("vram_gb") if g.get("vram_gb") is not None else 0.0)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                vram_gb = 0.0
            backend = str(g.get("backend") or "").upper()
            vendor = "nvidia" if "CUDA" in backend or "NVIDIA" in name.upper() else "other"
            if "APPLE" in backend or "METAL" in backend:
                vendor = "apple"
            if "ROCM" in backend or "AMD" in name.upper():
                vendor = "amd"
            if "INTEL" in name.upper() or "ARC" in name.upper():
                vendor = "intel"
            out.append(
                {
                    "vendor": vendor,
                    "name": name,
                    "vram_mb": int(round(vram_gb * 1024)),
                    "source": "llmfit",
                    "backend": backend or None,
                    "unified_memory": bool(g.get("unified_memory")),
                }
            )
    elif sysinfo.get("has_gpu") and sysinfo.get("gpu_name"):
        try:
            vram_gb = float(sysinfo.get("gpu_vram_gb") or 0.0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            vram_gb = 0.0
        name = str(sysinfo.get("gpu_name") or "GPU")
        backend = str(sysinfo.get("backend") or "").upper()
        vendor = "nvidia" if "CUDA" in backend else "other"
        out.append(
            {
                "vendor": vendor,
                "name": name,
                "vram_mb": int(round(vram_gb * 1024)),
                "source": "llmfit",
                "backend": backend or None,
                "unified_memory": bool(sysinfo.get("unified_memory")),
            }
        )
    # Drop zero-VRAM stubs when any positive-VRAM device exists
    if any(g.get("vram_mb", 0) > 0 for g in out):
        out = [g for g in out if int(g.get("vram_mb") or 0) > 256]
    return out

) -> QWidget:
    """QWidget with a scrollable markdown view of ``md_path`` (HELPER or abs)."""
    path = Path(md_path)
    if not path.is_absolute():
        path = helper_md_path(str(md_path))

    wrap = QWidget()
    lay = QVBoxLayout(wrap)
    lay.setContentsMargins(12, 12, 12, 12)

    browser = QTextBrowser()
    browser.setOpenExternalLinks(True)
    browser.setStyleSheet(
        f"""
        QTextBrowser {{
            background: {theme.get('panel_bg', theme.get('bg', '#1e1e1e'))};
            color: {theme.get('fg', '#e0e0e0')};
            border: 1px solid {theme.get('border', '#444')};
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 12px;
            font-size: 13px;
        }}
        """
    )

    if path.is_file():
        try:
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError as e:
            text = f"# Missing HELPER doc\n\nCould not read `{path}`: {e}"
        browser.setMarkdown(text)
        lay.addWidget(browser)
    else:
        title = QLabel(fallback_title)
        title.setStyleSheet("font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold;")
        sub = QLabel(
            fallback_subtitle
            or f"Create `{HELPER_DIR}/{path.name}` for this module’s Home page."
        )
        sub.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(title)
        lay.addWidget(sub)
        lay.addStretch()

    wrap._md_path = path  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    wrap._browser = browser if path.is_file() else None  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    return wrap

def helper_md_path(filename: str) -> Path:
    """Resolve a HELPER doc under AIHelperDocuments/ (or absolute / repo-relative path)."""
    p = Path(filename)
    if p.is_absolute():
        return p
    if len(p.parts) > 1:
        return ROOT / p
    return ROOT / HELPER_DIR / p

class McpAdapterHost:
    """Start/stop/find the MCP adapter and feed McpControlPanel callbacks."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: Dict[str, Any],
        save_config: Callable[[], None],
        *,
        parent: Optional[QWidget] = None,
    ):
        self.config = config
        self._save_config = save_config
        self.parent = parent
        self.panel = None
        self.adapter_proc: Optional[subprocess.Popen] = None
        self._last_reap_ts: float = 0.0
        self._http_work_busy: bool = False
        self._http_async_pending: bool = False

    # --- environment ---
    def script_path(self) -> Path:
        return ROOT / "scripts" / ADAPTER_SCRIPT_NAME

    def python_exe(self) -> Path:
        for candidate in (
            ROOT / ".venv" / "bin" / "python",
            ROOT / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe",
        ):
            if candidate.is_file():
                return candidate
        return Path(sys.executable)

    def _save(self) -> None:
        try:
            self._save_config()
        except Exception:
            pass

    # --- discovery ---
    def _ps_python_dump(self) -> str:
        """List python processes (Windows: PowerShell CIM; Linux/macOS: psutil)."""
        if os.name != "nt":
            try:
                import psutil
            except ImportError as e:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "psutil is required to list MCP adapter processes on Linux/macOS"
                ) from e
            lines: List[str] = []
            for proc in psutil.process_iter(["pid", "name", "cmdline"]):
                try:
                    name = (proc.info.get("name") or "").lower()
                    cmd = proc.info.get("cmdline") or []
                    if "python" not in name and not any(
                        "python" in str(c).lower() for c in cmd[:1]
                    ):
                        continue
                    cl = " ".join(str(c) for c in cmd)
                    lines.append(f"{proc.info.get('pid')} {cl}")
                except (psutil.Error, TypeError, ValueError):
                    continue
            return "\n".join(lines) if lines else "(No python processes found.)"
        cmd = (
            "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | "
            "Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'python' } | "
            "Select-Object ProcessId, CommandLine | "
            "Format-Table -Auto | Out-String -Width 4000"
        )
        try:
            p = subprocess.run(
                ["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", cmd],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=20,
            )
        except OSError as e:
            raise RuntimeError(f"PowerShell unavailable: {e}") from e
        out = (p.stdout or "").strip()
        err = (p.stderr or "").strip()
        if p.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(err or f"PowerShell failed with exit code {p.returncode}")
        return out or "(No python processes found.)"

    def _script_fold(self) -> str:
        return _fold(str(self.script_path()))

    def _line_is_ours(self, line: str) -> bool:
        return self._script_fold() in _fold(line)

    def _all_adapter_processes(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        try:
            from spock_health_report import discover_mcp_adapter_pids

            return list(discover_mcp_adapter_pids() or [])
        except Exception:
            return []

    def find_text(self, needle: str = ADAPTER_SCRIPT_NAME) -> str:
        txt = self._ps_python_dump()
        hits = [line for line in txt.splitlines() if needle.lower() in line.lower()]
        script = self.script_path()
        ours = [line for line in hits if self._line_is_ours(line)]
        foreign = [line for line in hits if not self._line_is_ours(line)]
        header = (
            f"This install: {script}\n"
            "Start/Stop from Spock manages every process running this script.\n"
        )
        if not hits:
            if script.is_file():
                return (
                    f"{header}\nNot found (running): {needle}\n\n"
                    "No active python process is running it.\n"
                    "Start from project root with:\n"
                    f'"{self.python_exe()}" "{script}"'
                    "\n\n"
                    f"Full list:\n{txt}"
                )
            return (
                f"{header}\nNot found: {needle}\n\n"
                f"Script missing: {script}\n\nFull list:\n{txt}"
            )
        blocks = [header]
        if ours:
            blocks.append("This install:\n" + "\n".join(ours))
        if foreign:
            blocks.append(
                "OTHER install(s) — not started/stopped by this Spock "
                "(often leftover Cursor mcp.json):\n" + "\n".join(foreign)
            )
        return "\n\n".join(blocks)

    def running_pids(self) -> List[str]:
        """PIDs for THIS repo's scripts/mcp_spock_server.py only."""
        marker = self._script_fold()
        pids: List[str] = []
        for proc in self._all_adapter_processes():
            if marker in _fold(str(proc.get("cmdline") or "")):
                pids.append(str(proc.get("pid") or ""))
        pids = [p for p in pids if p.isdigit()]
        if pids:
            return pids
        try:
            txt = self._ps_python_dump()
        except Exception:
            return []
        fallback: List[str] = []
        for line in txt.splitlines():
            if ADAPTER_SCRIPT_NAME.lower() not in line.lower():
                continue
            if not self._line_is_ours(line):
                continue
            parts = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)
            if parts and parts[0].isdigit():
                fallback.append(parts[0])
        return fallback

    def adapter_status_text(self) -> str:
        if self.adapter_proc is not None and self.adapter_proc.poll() is not None:
            self.adapter_proc = None
        pids = self.running_pids()
        if pids:
            return f"running ({len(pids)} process(es))"
        return "stopped"

    def _maybe_reap_http_duplicates(self) -> None:
        """Drop extra Spock HTTP adapter PIDs (Start path only — not status polls)."""
        now = time.time()
        if now - self._last_reap_ts < 30.0:
            return
        pids = self.running_pids()
        if len(pids) <= 1:
            return
        mcp = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
        transport = str(mcp.get("transport") or "streamable-http").strip().lower()
        if transport not in _HTTP_TRANSPORTS:
            return
        host = str(mcp.get("http_host") or "127.0.0.1")
        try:
            port = int(mcp.get("http_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            port = DEFAULT_MCP_PORT
        killed = self._reap_duplicate_http_adapters(host, port, transport)
        if killed:
            self._last_reap_ts = now
            print(f"[mcp] reaped duplicate adapter PIDs: {', '.join(killed)}")

    # --- panel callbacks ---
    def health_context(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        rag = self.config.get("rag_api") or {}
        host = rag.get("host", "127.0.0.1")
        port = int(rag.get("port", DEFAULT_RAG_PORT))
        ep = self.config.get("embedding_profile") or {}
        try:
            chat_port = int(self.config.get("llama_port") or 8081)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            chat_port = 8081
        mcp = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
        return {
            "api_base": f"http://{host}:{port}",
            "db_path": SHIP_COMPUTER_DB,
            "embeddings_url": str(
                ep.get("embeddings_url") or "http://localhost:8080/embeddings"
            ),
            "api_key": str(rag.get("api_key") or ""),
            "chat_host": str(self.config.get("llama_host") or "localhost"),
            "chat_port": chat_port,
            "mcp_host": str(mcp.get("http_host") or "127.0.0.1"),
            "mcp_port": int(mcp.get("http_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT),
            "mcp_transport": str(mcp.get("transport") or "streamable-http"),
            "webui_host": str(mcp.get("webui_host") or "127.0.0.1"),
            "webui_port": int(mcp.get("webui_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_WEBUI_PORT),
        }

    def on_settings_changed(self, settings: dict) -> None:
        """Merge a panel's partial update so sibling panels never clobber it."""
        block = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
        block.update(
            {k: v for k, v in (settings or {}).items() if k in DEFAULT_MCP_SETTINGS}
        )
        merged = merge_mcp_settings(block)
        self.config["mcp"] = merged
        self.config["mcp_http_port"] = int(merged.get("http_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT)
        self._save()

    def refresh_panel(self) -> None:
        if self.panel is not None:
            try:
                self.panel.refresh_status()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _pid_cwd(self, pid: str) -> str:
        try:
            import psutil

            return str(psutil.Process(int(pid)).cwd())
        except Exception:
            return ""

    def _pid_age_seconds(self, pid: str) -> float:
        try:
            import psutil

            return time.time() - psutil.Process(int(pid)).create_time()
        except Exception:
            return 9999.0

    def _kill_stale_spock_adapters(self, port: int) -> List[str]:
        """Drop this-install Spock-spawned PIDs that never bound :port (not Cursor stdio)."""
        root_fold = _fold(str(ROOT))
        listeners = set(self._pids_listening_on(int(port)))
        killed: List[str] = []
        own_pid = (
            str(self.adapter_proc.pid)
            if self.adapter_proc is not None and self.adapter_proc.poll() is None
            else ""
        )
        for pid in self.running_pids():
            if pid in listeners or pid == own_pid:
                continue
            if self._pid_age_seconds(pid) < 20.0:
                continue
            cwd = _fold(self._pid_cwd(pid))
            if not cwd or root_fold not in cwd:
                continue
            if self._taskkill(pid, tree=False):
                killed.append(pid)
        if killed:
            time.sleep(0.35)
        return killed

    def _spawn_stderr_path(self, pid: int | str | None = None) -> Path:
        if pid and str(pid) not in ("0", ""):
            return ROOT / "logs" / f"mcp-adapter-{pid}.stderr.log"
        return ROOT / "logs" / "mcp-adapter-last.stderr.log"

    def _read_spawn_failure(self, proc: subprocess.Popen, stderr_path: Path) -> str:
        lines: List[str] = []
        if stderr_path.is_file():
            try:
                lines = stderr_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
            except OSError:
                pass
        tail = "\n".join(lines[-16:]).strip()
        code = proc.poll()
        base = f"Adapter exited (code {code})." if code is not None else (
            "Adapter started but never opened the HTTP port."
        )
        if tail:
            return f"{base}\n\nStderr/log tail:\n{tail}"
        return (
            f"{base}\n\nSee {ROOT / 'logs' / 'spock-mcp.log'} and {stderr_path}."
        )

    def ensure_http_adapter(self, *, quiet: bool = True) -> bool:
        """Start streamable-http when autostart expects it and :port is down."""
        mcp = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
        transport = str(mcp.get("transport") or "streamable-http").strip().lower()
        if transport not in _HTTP_TRANSPORTS:
            return False
        host = str(mcp.get("http_host") or "127.0.0.1")
        try:
            port = int(mcp.get("http_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            port = DEFAULT_MCP_PORT
        from spock_shell.proc_guard import tcp_open

        if tcp_open(host, port) or self._http_reachable(host, port, transport):
            return True
        self.start_adapter(
            quiet=quiet,
            transport=transport,
            http_host=host,
            http_port=port,
        )
        return tcp_open(host, port) or self._http_reachable(host, port, transport)

    def ensure_http_adapter_async(self, *, quiet: bool = True) -> None:
        """Start HTTP adapter on a worker thread so the Qt UI stays responsive."""
        if self._http_work_busy or self._http_async_pending:
            return
        mcp = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
        transport = str(mcp.get("transport") or "streamable-http").strip().lower()
        if transport not in _HTTP_TRANSPORTS:
            return
        host = str(mcp.get("http_host") or "127.0.0.1")
        try:
            port = int(mcp.get("http_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            port = DEFAULT_MCP_PORT
        from spock_shell.proc_guard import tcp_open

        if tcp_open(host, port) or self._http_reachable(host, port, transport):
            return

        self._http_async_pending = True

        def _work() -> None:
            try:
                self.ensure_http_adapter(quiet=quiet)
            finally:
                self._http_async_pending = False
                QTimer.singleShot(0, self.refresh_panel)

        threading.Thread(target=_work, daemon=True, name="mcp-http-start").start()

    # --- lifecycle ---
    def start_adapter(
        self,
        quiet: bool = False,
        transport: Optional[str] = None,
        http_host: Optional[str] = None,
        http_port: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Start MCP adapter using saved MCP settings unless overrides are passed."""
        script = self.script_path()
        python_exe = self.python_exe()
        mcp = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
        if transport is None or not str(transport).strip():
            transport = str(mcp.get("transport") or "streamable-http")
        if http_host is None or not str(http_host).strip():
            http_host = str(mcp.get("http_host") or "127.0.0.1")
        if http_port is None:
            try:
                http_port = int(mcp.get("http_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                http_port = DEFAULT_MCP_PORT

        if not script.is_file():
            if not quiet:
                QMessageBox.critical(
                    self.parent, "MCP adapter", f"Script not found:\n{script}"
                )
            return
        if not python_exe.is_file():
            if not quiet:
                QMessageBox.critical(
                    self.parent, "MCP adapter", f"Python not found:\n{python_exe}"
                )
            return

        want_http = (transport or "stdio").strip().lower() in _HTTP_TRANSPORTS
        if want_http and self._http_work_busy:
            if not quiet:
                QMessageBox.information(
                    self.parent,
                    "MCP adapter",
                    "HTTP adapter start already in progress…",
                )
            return
        from contextlib import nullcontext

        from spock_shell.proc_guard import exclusive_start, tcp_open

        if want_http:
            self._http_work_busy = True
        try:
            if want_http:
                self._kill_stale_spock_adapters(int(http_port))
                from spock_shell.proc_guard import tcp_open as _tcp

                if _tcp(str(http_host), int(http_port)) or self._http_reachable(
                    str(http_host), int(http_port), str(transport)
                ):
                    if not quiet:
                        QMessageBox.information(
                            self.parent,
                            "MCP adapter",
                            f"HTTP MCP adapter already listening on "
                            f"{http_host}:{http_port}",
                        )
                    return
                self._maybe_reap_http_duplicates()

            lock_ctx = exclusive_start("mcp_http") if want_http else nullcontext(True)
            with lock_ctx as locked:
                # Skip a second HTTP copy. One Cursor stdio plus one HTTP is OK;
                # any other this-install PID without a listener is a Start race.
                if want_http:
                    reason = self._http_start_skip_reason(
                        str(http_host), int(http_port), str(transport)
                    )
                    if not reason and not locked:
                        if self._wait_for_http_ready(
                            str(http_host), int(http_port), str(transport), timeout=2.0
                        ):
                            reason = (
                                f"HTTP MCP adapter already listening on "
                                f"{http_host}:{http_port}"
                            )
                    if reason:
                        pids = self.running_pids()
                        if pids:
                            reason += f"\nThis install PID(s): {', '.join(pids)}"
                        self.refresh_panel()
                        if not quiet:
                            show_output_dialog(
                                self.parent,
                                "Start MCP adapter",
                                f"{reason}.\n\nNot spawning another copy.\n\n"
                                f"{self.find_text()}",
                            )
                        else:
                            print(f"[profile] MCP adapter: {reason}; skipped start")
                        return
                else:
                    existing = self.running_pids()
                    if existing:
                        self.refresh_panel()
                        if not quiet:
                            show_output_dialog(
                                self.parent,
                                "Start MCP adapter",
                                "MCP adapter already running for this install.\n\n"
                                f"Existing PID(s): {', '.join(existing)}\n\n"
                                f"{self.find_text()}",
                            )
                        return

                env = os.environ.copy()
                rag = self.config.get("rag_api") or {}
                host = rag.get("host", "127.0.0.1")
                port = int(rag.get("port", DEFAULT_RAG_PORT))
                env["SPOCK_API_BASE_URL"] = f"http://{host}:{port}"
                if rag.get("api_key"):
                    env["SPOCK_API_KEY"] = str(rag["api_key"])
                env["SPOCK_DB_PATH"] = SHIP_COMPUTER_DB
                ep = self.config.get("embedding_profile") or {}
                if ep.get("embeddings_url"):
                    env["SPOCK_EMBEDDINGS_URL"] = str(ep["embeddings_url"])
                env["SPOCK_MCP_LOG_PATH"] = str(ROOT / "logs" / "spock-mcp.log")
                transport = (transport or "stdio").strip().lower()
                if transport in _HTTP_TRANSPORTS:
                    if transport in ("http", "streamable_http"):
                        transport = "streamable-http"
                    env["SPOCK_MCP_TRANSPORT"] = transport
                    env["SPOCK_MCP_HOST"] = (http_host or "127.0.0.1").strip() or "127.0.0.1"
                    port_i = (
                        int(http_port)
                        if http_port is not None
                        else int(
                            mcp.get("http_port")
                            or self.config.get("mcp_http_port")
                            or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT
                        )
                    )
                    env["SPOCK_MCP_PORT"] = str(port_i)
                    self.config["mcp_http_port"] = port_i
                    mcp_block = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
                    mcp_block["transport"] = transport
                    mcp_block["http_host"] = env["SPOCK_MCP_HOST"]
                    mcp_block["http_port"] = port_i
                    self.config["mcp"] = mcp_block
                    self._save()
                else:
                    env["SPOCK_MCP_TRANSPORT"] = "stdio"
                try:
                    (ROOT / "logs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                except OSError:
                    pass

                stderr_path = self._spawn_stderr_path()
                stderr_fh = None
                try:
                    stderr_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    stderr_fh = open(stderr_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
                except OSError:
                    stderr_fh = None

                creationflags = 0
                if os.name == "nt":
                    creationflags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
                try:
                    proc = subprocess.Popen(
                        [str(python_exe), "-u", str(script)],
                        cwd=str(ROOT),
                        env=env,
                        stdin=(
                            subprocess.PIPE
                            if env["SPOCK_MCP_TRANSPORT"] == "stdio"
                            else subprocess.DEVNULL
                        ),
                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stderr=stderr_fh or subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        creationflags=creationflags,
                    )
                except OSError as e:
                    if stderr_fh is not None:
                        stderr_fh.close()
                    if not quiet:
                        QMessageBox.critical(
                            self.parent, "MCP adapter", f"Failed to launch:\n{e}"
                        )
                    else:
                        print(f"[profile] MCP adapter launch failed: {e}")
                    return

                if stderr_fh is not None:
                    stderr_fh.close()

                if proc.poll() is not None:
                    if not quiet:
                        QMessageBox.critical(
                            self.parent,
                            "MCP adapter",
                            "MCP adapter exited immediately after launch.\n"
                            "Install deps: pip install -r requirements-mcp.txt\n"
                            f"Log: {env.get('SPOCK_MCP_LOG_PATH')}",
                        )
                    else:
                        print(
                            "[profile] MCP adapter exited immediately; "
                            f"see {env.get('SPOCK_MCP_LOG_PATH')}"
                        )
                    return

                self.adapter_proc = proc
                http_ready = True
                if want_http:
                    deadline = time.time() + 20.0
                    http_ready = False
                    while time.time() < deadline:
                        if proc.poll() is not None:
                            break
                        if tcp_open(str(http_host), int(http_port)):
                            http_ready = True
                            break
                        if self._http_reachable(
                            str(http_host), int(http_port), str(transport)
                        ):
                            http_ready = True
                            break
                        time.sleep(0.2)
                    if not http_ready and proc.poll() is None:
                        http_ready = (
                            tcp_open(str(http_host), int(http_port))
                            or self._http_reachable(
                                str(http_host), int(http_port), str(transport)
                            )
                        )
                    if not http_ready:
                        fail = self._read_spawn_failure(
                            proc, self._spawn_stderr_path(proc.pid)
                        )
                        try:
                            if proc.poll() is None:
                                proc.terminate()
                                proc.wait(timeout=2)
                        except Exception:
                            try:
                                proc.kill()
                            except Exception:
                                pass
                        self.adapter_proc = None
                        self.refresh_panel()
                        if not quiet:
                            QMessageBox.critical(
                                self.parent,
                                "MCP adapter",
                                "HTTP adapter did not open the port.\n\n"
                                f"{fail}\n\n"
                                "Cursor stdio copies (cwd ≠ repo) do not serve "
                                f"http://{http_host}:{http_port}/mcp — only "
                                "streamable-http from this panel does.",
                            )
                        else:
                            print(f"[profile] MCP adapter failed to bind: {fail}")
                        return
                else:
                    time.sleep(0.8)

            find_output = self.find_text()
            self.refresh_panel()
            if quiet:
                print(
                    f"[profile] MCP adapter started "
                    f"({env.get('SPOCK_MCP_TRANSPORT')} "
                    f"{env.get('SPOCK_MCP_HOST', '')}:{env.get('SPOCK_MCP_PORT', '')})"
                )
                return

            mcp_port = env.get("SPOCK_MCP_PORT", str(DEFAULT_MCP_PORT))
            mcp_host = env.get("SPOCK_MCP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
            if env["SPOCK_MCP_TRANSPORT"] == "stdio":
                snippet = (
                    "{\n"
                    '  "mcpServers": {\n'
                    '    "spock-to-bridge": {\n'
                    f'      "command": "{python_exe.as_posix()}",\n'
                    f'      "args": ["-u", "{script.as_posix()}"]\n'
                    "    }\n"
                    "  }\n"
                    "}"
                )
                body = (
                    "MCP adapter launch requested (stdio).\n\n"
                    f"PID: {proc.pid}\n"
                    f'Command: "{python_exe}" -u "{script}"\n\n'
                    "Cursor/OpenCode use mcp.json (stdio).\n"
                    "Example mcp.json entry:\n"
                    f"{snippet}\n\n"
                    f"Auto-check:\n{find_output}"
                )
            else:
                url_mcp = f"http://{mcp_host}:{mcp_port}/mcp"
                url_sse = f"http://{mcp_host}:{mcp_port}/sse"
                body = (
                    "MCP adapter launch requested (HTTP for llama.cpp WebUI).\n\n"
                    f"PID: {proc.pid}\n"
                    f"Transport: {env['SPOCK_MCP_TRANSPORT']}\n\n"
                    "In llama.cpp browser MCP dialog, set Server URL to:\n"
                    f"  {url_mcp}\n"
                    f"(SSE fallback: {url_sse})\n\n"
                    "Tips:\n"
                    "1. CORS is enabled on this HTTP adapter\n"
                    "2. Optional: llama.cpp WebUI → Start --ui-mcp-proxy\n"
                    "3. Prefer 127.0.0.1; toggle the server ON\n"
                    "4. Run → START RAG API so spock_ask works\n"
                    "5. Tools: spock_search_kb, spock_ask, spock_health, spock_llmfit_fit, …\n\n"
                    f"Auto-check:\n{find_output}"
                )
            show_output_dialog(self.parent, "Start MCP adapter", body)
            if self.panel is not None:
                try:
                    self.panel.adapter_log.append(body)
                    self.panel.refresh_status()
                except Exception:
                    pass
        finally:
            if want_http:
                self._http_work_busy = False

    def _wait_for_http_ready(
        self,
        host: str,
        port: int,
        transport: str,
        timeout: float = 10.0,
    ) -> bool:
        """True when :port answers or every peer PID exited."""
        from spock_shell.proc_guard import tcp_open

        deadline = time.time() + max(0.5, float(timeout))
        while time.time() < deadline:
            if self._http_reachable(host, port, transport) or tcp_open(host, port):
                return True
            if not self.running_pids():
                return False
            time.sleep(0.25)
        return self._http_reachable(host, port, transport) or tcp_open(host, port)

    def _reap_duplicate_http_adapters(
        self, host: str, port: int, transport: str
    ) -> List[str]:
        """Kill extra Spock-spawned HTTP adapters; keep the PID bound on :port."""
        root_fold = _fold(str(ROOT))
        pids = self.running_pids()
        if len(pids) <= 1:
            return []
        listeners = self._pids_listening_on(port)
        if len(listeners) == 1:
            keep = listeners[0]
        elif listeners:
            keep = listeners[0]
        elif self._http_reachable(host, port, transport):
            return []
        else:
            return []
        killed: List[str] = []
        for pid in pids:
            if pid == keep:
                continue
            cwd = _fold(self._pid_cwd(pid))
            if not cwd or root_fold not in cwd:
                continue
            if self._taskkill(pid, tree=False):
                killed.append(pid)
        if killed:
            time.sleep(0.35)
        return killed

    def _http_start_skip_reason(
        self, host: str, port: int, transport: str
    ) -> str:
        """Why Start must not spawn another HTTP copy. Empty = allowed."""
        if self._http_reachable(host, port, transport):
            return f"HTTP MCP adapter already listening on {host}:{port}"
        from spock_shell.proc_guard import tcp_open

        if tcp_open(host, port):
            return f"port {host}:{port} already in use"
        bound = self._pids_listening_on(int(port))
        if bound:
            return (
                "HTTP MCP adapter already bound on "
                f"{host}:{port} (PIDs {', '.join(bound)})"
            )
        if self.adapter_proc is not None and self.adapter_proc.poll() is None:
            return f"HTTP MCP adapter already started (PID {self.adapter_proc.pid})"

        existing = self.running_pids()
        if not existing:
            return ""

        if self._wait_for_http_ready(host, port, transport, timeout=1.0):
            return f"HTTP MCP adapter already listening on {host}:{port}"

        http_pids = self._http_pids()
        if http_pids:
            return (
                "HTTP MCP adapter already running (PIDs "
                f"{', '.join(http_pids)})"
            )

        # No listener on :port — remaining PIDs are Cursor stdio copies or a
        # failed bind. HTTP spawn is allowed (stdio does not hold :8765).
        return ""

    def _http_reachable(self, host: str, port: int, transport: str) -> bool:
        try:
            from spock_health_report import probe_mcp_adapter

            info = probe_mcp_adapter(
                host, port, transport=transport or "streamable-http", timeout=1.0
            )
            return bool(info.get("reachable"))
        except Exception:
            return False

    def _pids_listening_on(self, port: int) -> List[str]:
        """This-install adapter PIDs with a LISTEN socket on port (HTTP, not stdio)."""
        found: List[str] = []
        ours = {int(p) for p in self.running_pids() if str(p).isdigit()}
        if not ours:
            return found
        try:
            import psutil
        except ImportError:
            return found
        try:
            port_i = int(port)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return found
        for pid in sorted(ours):
            try:
                proc = psutil.Process(pid)
                conns = proc.net_connections(kind="inet")
            except Exception:
                continue
            for conn in conns or []:
                try:
                    laddr = conn.laddr
                    status = str(getattr(conn, "status", "") or "")
                    if not laddr:
                        continue
                    if int(getattr(laddr, "port", 0) or 0) != port_i:
                        continue
                    if status.upper() in ("LISTEN", "LISTENING", ""):
                        found.append(str(pid))
                        break
                except Exception:
                    continue
        return found

    def _http_pids(self) -> List[str]:
        env_hits = [
            pid
            for pid in self.running_pids()
            if _mcp_transport_for_pid(pid) in _HTTP_TRANSPORTS
        ]
        mcp = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
        try:
            port = int(mcp.get("http_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            port = DEFAULT_MCP_PORT
        bound = self._pids_listening_on(port)
        # Env is often unreadable on Windows; LISTEN sockets are the source of truth.
        return list(dict.fromkeys(env_hits + bound))

    def _taskkill(self, pid: str, *, tree: bool = True) -> bool:
        if os.name != "nt":
            try:
                import signal

                import psutil

                proc = psutil.Process(int(pid))
                if tree:
                    for child in proc.children(recursive=True):
                        try:
                            child.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
                        except (psutil.Error, ProcessLookupError):
                            pass
                proc.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    proc.wait(timeout=2)
                except psutil.TimeoutExpired:
                    proc.kill()
                return True
            except Exception:
                try:
                    import signal as _signal

                    os.kill(int(pid), _signal.SIGTERM)
                    return True
                except Exception:
                    return False
        try:
            args = ["taskkill", "/PID", str(pid), "/F"]
            if tree:
                args.insert(2, "/T")
            p = subprocess.run(
                args,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=10,
            )
            return p.returncode == 0
        except Exception:
            return False

    def kill_processes(self) -> List[str]:
        """Stop every this-install mcp_spock_server.py (HTTP and stdio)."""
        killed: List[str] = []
        if self.adapter_proc is not None:
            try:
                if self.adapter_proc.poll() is None:
                    pid = str(self.adapter_proc.pid)
                    self.adapter_proc.terminate()
                    try:
                        self.adapter_proc.wait(timeout=2)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        self.adapter_proc.kill()
                    killed.append(pid)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.adapter_proc = None

        for pid in self.running_pids():
            if pid in killed:
                continue
            if self._taskkill(pid):
                killed.append(pid)
        time.sleep(0.4)
        for pid in self.running_pids():
            if pid in killed:
                continue
            if self._taskkill(pid):
                killed.append(pid)
        return killed

    def stop_adapter(self) -> None:
        killed = self.kill_processes()
        leftover = self.running_pids()
        self.refresh_panel()
        if leftover:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self.parent,
                "Stop MCP adapter",
                "Tried to stop this install's MCP adapter PID(s): "
                f"{', '.join(killed) or '(none)'}\n\n"
                f"Still running: {', '.join(leftover)}\n"
                "Cursor may immediately respawn stdio adapters from mcp.json.",
            )
            return
        if killed:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self.parent,
                "Stop MCP adapter",
                "Stopped this install's MCP adapter PID(s): "
                f"{', '.join(killed)}\n\n"
                "Cursor may respawn a stdio adapter from mcp.json; "
                "that is one copy, not a Spock duplicate.",
            )
            return
        QMessageBox.information(
            self.parent,
            "Stop MCP adapter",
            f"No running {ADAPTER_SCRIPT_NAME} for this install.",
        )

    def find_adapter(self) -> None:
        try:
            text = self.find_text(ADAPTER_SCRIPT_NAME)
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.critical(self.parent, "Find MCP adapter", str(e))
            return
        self.refresh_panel()
        show_output_dialog(self.parent, "Find MCP adapter", text)

def ensure_http_adapter(self, *, quiet: bool = True) -> bool:
    """Start streamable-http when autostart expects it and :port is down."""
    mcp = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
    transport = str(mcp.get("transport") or "streamable-http").strip().lower()
    if transport not in _HTTP_TRANSPORTS:
        return False
    host = str(mcp.get("http_host") or "127.0.0.1")
    try:
        port = int(mcp.get("http_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        port = DEFAULT_MCP_PORT
    from spock_shell.proc_guard import tcp_open

    if tcp_open(host, port) or self._http_reachable(host, port, transport):
        return True
    self.start_adapter(
        quiet=quiet,
        transport=transport,
        http_host=host,
        http_port=port,
    )
    return tcp_open(host, port) or self._http_reachable(host, port, transport)

def ensure_http_adapter_async(self, *, quiet: bool = True) -> None:
    """Start HTTP adapter on a worker thread so the Qt UI stays responsive."""
    if self._http_work_busy or self._http_async_pending:
        return
    mcp = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
    transport = str(mcp.get("transport") or "streamable-http").strip().lower()
    if transport not in _HTTP_TRANSPORTS:
        return
    host = str(mcp.get("http_host") or "127.0.0.1")
    try:
        port = int(mcp.get("http_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        port = DEFAULT_MCP_PORT
    from spock_shell.proc_guard import tcp_open

    if tcp_open(host, port) or self._http_reachable(host, port, transport):
        return

    self._http_async_pending = True

    def _work() -> None:
        try:
            self.ensure_http_adapter(quiet=quiet)
        finally:
            self._http_async_pending = False
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self.refresh_panel)

    threading.Thread(target=_work, daemon=True, name="mcp-http-start").start()

def on_settings_changed(self, settings: dict) -> None:
    """Merge a panel's partial update so sibling panels never clobber it."""
    block = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
    block.update(
        {k: v for k, v in (settings or {}).items() if k in DEFAULT_MCP_SETTINGS}
    )
    merged = merge_mcp_settings(block)
    self.config["mcp"] = merged
    self.config["mcp_http_port"] = int(merged.get("http_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT)
    self._save()

def running_pids(self) -> List[str]:
    """PIDs for THIS repo's scripts/mcp_spock_server.py only."""
    marker = self._script_fold()
    pids: List[str] = []
    for proc in self._all_adapter_processes():
        if marker in _fold(str(proc.get("cmdline") or "")):
            pids.append(str(proc.get("pid") or ""))
    pids = [p for p in pids if p.isdigit()]
    if pids:
        return pids
    try:
        txt = self._ps_python_dump()
    except Exception:
        return []
    fallback: List[str] = []
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        if ADAPTER_SCRIPT_NAME.lower() not in line.lower():
            continue
        if not self._line_is_ours(line):
            continue
        parts = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)
        if parts and parts[0].isdigit():
            fallback.append(parts[0])
    return fallback

def start_adapter(
    self,
    quiet: bool = False,
    transport: Optional[str] = None,
    http_host: Optional[str] = None,
    http_port: Optional[int] = None,
) -> None:
    """Start MCP adapter using saved MCP settings unless overrides are passed."""
    script = self.script_path()
    python_exe = self.python_exe()
    mcp = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
    if transport is None or not str(transport).strip():
        transport = str(mcp.get("transport") or "streamable-http")
    if http_host is None or not str(http_host).strip():
        http_host = str(mcp.get("http_host") or "127.0.0.1")
    if http_port is None:
        try:
            http_port = int(mcp.get("http_port") or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            http_port = DEFAULT_MCP_PORT

    if not script.is_file():
        if not quiet:
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self.parent, "MCP adapter", f"Script not found:\n{script}"
            )
        return
    if not python_exe.is_file():
        if not quiet:
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self.parent, "MCP adapter", f"Python not found:\n{python_exe}"
            )
        return

    want_http = (transport or "stdio").strip().lower() in _HTTP_TRANSPORTS
    if want_http and self._http_work_busy:
        if not quiet:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self.parent,
                "MCP adapter",
                "HTTP adapter start already in progress…",
            )
        return
    from contextlib import nullcontext

    from spock_shell.proc_guard import exclusive_start, tcp_open

    if want_http:
        self._http_work_busy = True
    try:
        if want_http:
            self._kill_stale_spock_adapters(int(http_port))
            from spock_shell.proc_guard import tcp_open as _tcp

            if _tcp(str(http_host), int(http_port)) or self._http_reachable(
                str(http_host), int(http_port), str(transport)
            ):
                if not quiet:
                    QMessageBox.information(
                        self.parent,
                        "MCP adapter",
                        f"HTTP MCP adapter already listening on "
                        f"{http_host}:{http_port}",
                    )
                return
            self._maybe_reap_http_duplicates()

        lock_ctx = exclusive_start("mcp_http") if want_http else nullcontext(True)
        with lock_ctx as locked:
            # Skip a second HTTP copy. One Cursor stdio plus one HTTP is OK;
            # any other this-install PID without a listener is a Start race.
            if want_http:
                reason = self._http_start_skip_reason(
                    str(http_host), int(http_port), str(transport)
                )
                if not reason and not locked:
                    if self._wait_for_http_ready(
                        str(http_host), int(http_port), str(transport), timeout=2.0
                    ):
                        reason = (
                            f"HTTP MCP adapter already listening on "
                            f"{http_host}:{http_port}"
                        )
                if reason:
                    pids = self.running_pids()
                    if pids:
                        reason += f"\nThis install PID(s): {', '.join(pids)}"
                    self.refresh_panel()
                    if not quiet:
                        show_output_dialog(
                            self.parent,
                            "Start MCP adapter",
                            f"{reason}.\n\nNot spawning another copy.\n\n"
                            f"{self.find_text()}",
                        )
                    else:
                        print(f"[profile] MCP adapter: {reason}; skipped start")
                    return
            else:
                existing = self.running_pids()
                if existing:
                    self.refresh_panel()
                    if not quiet:
                        show_output_dialog(
                            self.parent,
                            "Start MCP adapter",
                            "MCP adapter already running for this install.\n\n"
                            f"Existing PID(s): {', '.join(existing)}\n\n"
                            f"{self.find_text()}",
                        )
                    return

            env = os.environ.copy()
            rag = self.config.get("rag_api") or {}
            host = rag.get("host", "127.0.0.1")
            port = int(rag.get("port", DEFAULT_RAG_PORT))
            env["SPOCK_API_BASE_URL"] = f"http://{host}:{port}"
            if rag.get("api_key"):
                env["SPOCK_API_KEY"] = str(rag["api_key"])
            env["SPOCK_DB_PATH"] = SHIP_COMPUTER_DB
            ep = self.config.get("embedding_profile") or {}
            if ep.get("embeddings_url"):
                env["SPOCK_EMBEDDINGS_URL"] = str(ep["embeddings_url"])
            env["SPOCK_MCP_LOG_PATH"] = str(ROOT / "logs" / "spock-mcp.log")
            transport = (transport or "stdio").strip().lower()
            if transport in _HTTP_TRANSPORTS:
                if transport in ("http", "streamable_http"):
                    transport = "streamable-http"
                env["SPOCK_MCP_TRANSPORT"] = transport
                env["SPOCK_MCP_HOST"] = (http_host or "127.0.0.1").strip() or "127.0.0.1"
                port_i = (
                    int(http_port)
                    if http_port is not None
                    else int(
                        mcp.get("http_port")
                        or self.config.get("mcp_http_port")
                        or DEFAULT_MCP_PORT
                    )
                )
                env["SPOCK_MCP_PORT"] = str(port_i)
                self.config["mcp_http_port"] = port_i
                mcp_block = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
                mcp_block["transport"] = transport
                mcp_block["http_host"] = env["SPOCK_MCP_HOST"]
                mcp_block["http_port"] = port_i
                self.config["mcp"] = mcp_block
                self._save()
            else:
                env["SPOCK_MCP_TRANSPORT"] = "stdio"
            try:
                (ROOT / "logs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            except OSError:
                pass

            stderr_path = self._spawn_stderr_path()
            stderr_fh = None
            try:
                stderr_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                stderr_fh = open(stderr_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            except OSError:
                stderr_fh = None

            creationflags = 0
            if os.name == "nt":
                creationflags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
            try:
                proc = subprocess.Popen(
                    [str(python_exe), "-u", str(script)],
                    cwd=str(ROOT),
                    env=env,
                    stdin=(
                        subprocess.PIPE
                        if env["SPOCK_MCP_TRANSPORT"] == "stdio"
                        else subprocess.DEVNULL
                    ),
                    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    stderr=stderr_fh or subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    creationflags=creationflags,
                )
            except OSError as e:
                if stderr_fh is not None:
                    stderr_fh.close()
                if not quiet:
                    QMessageBox.critical(
                        self.parent, "MCP adapter", f"Failed to launch:\n{e}"
                    )
                else:
                    print(f"[profile] MCP adapter launch failed: {e}")
                return

            if stderr_fh is not None:
                stderr_fh.close()

            if proc.poll() is not None:
                if not quiet:
                    QMessageBox.critical(
                        self.parent,
                        "MCP adapter",
                        "MCP adapter exited immediately after launch.\n"
                        "Install deps: pip install -r requirements-mcp.txt\n"
                        f"Log: {env.get('SPOCK_MCP_LOG_PATH')}",
                    )
                else:
                    print(
                        "[profile] MCP adapter exited immediately; "
                        f"see {env.get('SPOCK_MCP_LOG_PATH')}"
                    )
                return

            self.adapter_proc = proc
            http_ready = True
            if want_http:
                deadline = time.time() + 20.0
                http_ready = False
                while time.time() < deadline:
                    if proc.poll() is not None:
                        break
                    if tcp_open(str(http_host), int(http_port)):
                        http_ready = True
                        break
                    if self._http_reachable(
                        str(http_host), int(http_port), str(transport)
                    ):
                        http_ready = True
                        break
                    time.sleep(0.2)
                if not http_ready and proc.poll() is None:
                    http_ready = (
                        tcp_open(str(http_host), int(http_port))
                        or self._http_reachable(
                            str(http_host), int(http_port), str(transport)
                        )
                    )
                if not http_ready:
                    fail = self._read_spawn_failure(
                        proc, self._spawn_stderr_path(proc.pid)
                    )
                    try:
                        if proc.poll() is None:
                            proc.terminate()
                            proc.wait(timeout=2)
                    except Exception:
                        try:
                            proc.kill()
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                    self.adapter_proc = None
                    self.refresh_panel()
                    if not quiet:
                        QMessageBox.critical(
                            self.parent,
                            "MCP adapter",
                            "HTTP adapter did not open the port.\n\n"
                            f"{fail}\n\n"
                            "Cursor stdio copies (cwd ≠ repo) do not serve "
                            f"http://{http_host}:{http_port}/mcp — only "
                            "streamable-http from this panel does.",
                        )
                    else:
                        print(f"[profile] MCP adapter failed to bind: {fail}")
                    return
            else:
                time.sleep(0.8)

        find_output = self.find_text()
        self.refresh_panel()
        if quiet:

            )

        mcp_host = env.get("SPOCK_MCP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
        if env["SPOCK_MCP_TRANSPORT"] == "stdio":
            snippet = (
                "{\n"
                '  "mcpServers": {\n'

                "MCP adapter launch requested (stdio).\n\n"
                f"PID: {proc.pid}\n"
                f'Command: "{python_exe}" -u "{script}"\n\n'
                "Cursor/OpenCode use mcp.json (stdio).\n"
                "Example mcp.json entry:\n"
                f"{snippet}\n\n"
                f"Auto-check:\n{find_output}"
            )
        else:
            url_mcp = f"http://{mcp_host}:{mcp_port}/mcp"
            url_sse = f"http://{mcp_host}:{mcp_port}/sse"
            body = (
                "MCP adapter launch requested (HTTP for llama.cpp WebUI).\n\n"
                f"PID: {proc.pid}\n"
                f"Transport: {env['SPOCK_MCP_TRANSPORT']}\n\n"
                "In llama.cpp browser MCP dialog, set Server URL to:\n"
                f"  {url_mcp}\n"
                f"(SSE fallback: {url_sse})\n\n"
                "Tips:\n"
                "1. CORS is enabled on this HTTP adapter\n"
                "2. Optional: llama.cpp WebUI → Start --ui-mcp-proxy\n"
